purpose: Prevent incorrect cross-board dedupe, reputation/contact enrichment, or application routing when employers have similar names or staffing intermediaries.
identityEvidencePriority: canonical employer career page or canonical listing employer ID
legal company identifier (ICO/VAT/company registry identifier) when publicly present in the listing

rules.identityUnknownPromotion: allowed only as a standalone candidate after normal BA/remote eligibility verification; never merge employer-level metadata from another identity
rules.locationRule: Employer identity confidence cannot override locationEligibility. Only ba-area or verified remote-ok can be recommended.
rules.remoteRule: Remote eligibility must be evidenced by the job listing/canonical source, not inferred from another vacancy at the same employer.

expectedBenefit: Avoid false duplicate suppression and prevent copying salary, remote policy, contacts, or requirements between unrelated or intermediary employer records.
